title.en: Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree

desc.zh: 用坐标与三层排序规则解决同位置节点的冲突。
desc.en: Use coordinates and three ordering keys to resolve nodes sharing a position.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space and O(n) output space

concepts.name: Vertical coordinates
concepts.description: Assign rows and columns from root paths.

concepts.name: Lexicographic ordering
concepts.description: Sort column, then row, then value; group contiguous columns.
